'''Frank Appel''' is a German manager who was CEO of [[Deutsche Post]] from 2008 to 2023.<ref name="Publishing2009">{{cite book|last=Publishing|first=DK|title=1000 CEOs|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=p-u4AOpIoeQC&pg=PA199|accessdate=5 April 2011|date=2009-08-17|publisher=Penguin|isbn=978-0-7566-7057-3|page=199}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.dpdhl.com/en/media_relations/press_releases/2011/angela_titzrath_2012_new_member_board_of_management_deutsche_post_dhl.html |title=Press Release DPDHL - Contract for CEO Frank Appel extended for another five years |access-date=2013-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170912144624/http://www.dpdhl.com/en/media_relations/press_releases/2011/angela_titzrath_2012_new_member_board_of_management_deutsche_post_dhl.html |archive-date=2017-09-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref> 

==Career==
A former [[McKinsey]] consultant, Appel first joined Deutsche Post in 2000.<ref>Matthias Inverardi and Nadine Schimroszik (4 December 2021), [https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/deutsche-post-ceo-could-become-deutsche-telekom-chairman-report-2021-12-04/ Deutsche Post CEO could become Deutsche Telekom chairman - report] ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref> From November 2002, he was a member of the Board of Management of Deutsche Post AG.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=206736|title=Deutsche Post DHL Group extends board member mandate of CEO Frank Appel|website=WebWire|access-date=2020-04-13}}</ref>

Appel was chairman of the [[supervisory board]] of Deutsche Postbank AG, but effective 31 December 2010, resigned his position on the supervisory board.<ref>[https://www.postbank.com/postbank/en/pr_press_releases_archive_2010_11045.html Change in Postbank Supervisory Board] Postbank, 2 December 2010</ref>

In his capacity as CEO, Appel accompanied [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] on various state visits abroad, including to China in 2012<ref>Christian Geinitz (4 February 2012), [https://www.faz.net/aktuell/wirtschaft/besuch-der-kanzlerin-china-will-europa-nicht-aufkaufen-11636929.html Besuch der Kanzlerin: China will Europa nicht aufkaufen] ''[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]]''.</ref> and in 2014.<ref>Ralf Schuler and Henrik Jeimke-Karge (7 March 2014), [https://www.bild.de/geld/wirtschaft/china/merkel-reisst-mit-wirtschafts-delegation-nach-china-36659106.bild.html China-Reise: Mit diesen Managern reist Merkel ins Reich der Mitte] ''[[BILD]]''.</ref>

At the shareholders' meeting on April 7, 2022, Appel was elected to the supervisory board of Deutsche Telekom AG until 2026. 
On the same day, he was elected by the supervisory board to succeed Ulrich Lehner as its chairman.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.telekom.com/de/investor-relations/management-und-corporate-governance/aufsichtsrat | title=Aufsichtsrat }}</ref>

* [[DHL Global Forwarding]], Chair of the Supervisory Board

* [[Deutsche Postbank]], Chair of the Supervisory Board (2008–2011)

==Personal life==
Appel was born in 1961,<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.europeanceo.com/profiles/frank-appel-deutsche-post/|title=Frank Appel {{!}} Deutsche Post|date=2014-12-12|work=European CEO|access-date=2017-03-02|language=en-US}}</ref> is married and is the [[father]] of two children.
He spent his childhood growing up in Hamburg.

==Education==
* 1989 - [[M.Sc.]] in chemistry at [[LMU Munich]], Munich, Germany.
* 1993 - [[PhD]] in [[neurobiology]] at [[ETH Zurich]], Zurich, Switzerland.
